structured.answer: Open an account at Pesagot and buy the IBI מחקה (4A) ת"א 125 fund (5112628) by monthly standing order. The page says about 86,045 ₪ after 10 years, but that is for its default 10,000 ₪ plus 500 ₪ a month, not my 30,000.

stuck.why: My amount is 30,000 but the page sat on 10,000 / 500 and I couldn't change it, so the big number isn't really mine
Never heard of Pesagot; the big bank Leumi is second and almost as cheap, so I wavered

stuck.why: Starts from a different account and fund than the one picked at the top; thought my choice had changed

stuck.where: Fund list with minus percents and minus shekels
stuck.why: Everything has a minus, which looks scary; I just took the smallest minus, the one already selected

findings.what: Default amount 10,000 ₪ drives the big headline number; easy to walk away with 86,045 as 'my' result
findings.where: Top inputs and main result card

findings.what: Lower step chart starts from a different account and fund (Harel / Jerusalem, 79,910) than the top choice, so it's confusing
The cheapest account is a name a beginner may not know; no reassurance about who it is
Funds are shown with minus percents and minus shekels, which reads like losses
